steps.en: Declare a source and a parameterized SQL tool in tools.yaml
steps.zh: 在 tools.yaml 里声明数据源和一条参数化 SQL 工具

steps.en: Start the server with your config
Opens pooled connections and publishes each tool over MCP at /mcp
steps.zh: 建好连接池，把每个工具通过 MCP 发布在 /mcp

steps.en: Load the toolset into your agent
steps.zh: 在你的 agent 里加载工具集

steps.en: On each call, binds the model's arguments into your statement and returns rows
steps.zh: 每次调用时把模型给的参数绑定进你的语句，返回结果行

value.en: Agents query your databases only through statements you wrote — no model-written SQL, no per-framework connection and auth glue
value.zh: agent 只能通过你写好的语句查库——不让模型写 SQL，也不用在每个框架里重复写连接和鉴权代码

sources: README.md Quick Start: Custom Tools — kind: source / kind: tool with type: postgres-sql, statement, parameters
README.md Run Toolbox — ./toolbox --config "tools.yaml"; MCP client url http://127.0.0.1:5000/mcp
